Hendricks County coat drive

Every kid warm this winter.

We're collecting gently used winter coats through October 11, then giving them away for free at the fairgrounds on Saturday, October 17.

Donate a coat Need a coat? Come Oct 17
Collecting coats
Until October 11

Gently used coats, all sizes, at drop-off sites around the county.

Free coat giveaway
Sat, Oct 17
10 AM – 2 PM

Come pick out a coat. No sign-up, no paperwork.

Where
Pavilion C

Sheep/Goat Barn, Hendricks County Fairgrounds, 1900 E Main St., Danville

Wear a costume. Trick-or-treat indoors.

Giveaway day is a party. Bring the kids in costume for indoor trick-or-treating and refreshments while you pick out coats.

Three ways to help

Donate a coat

Clean, gently used winter coats in any size. Drop them at any site below by October 11.

Spread the word

Share this page with your school, church, team, or neighbors.

Come if you need a coat

Everyone is welcome on October 17. Bring the whole family.
